title: Living-files map (owner L1, D-094-R117): one always-loaded map of the files Claude must keep up to date (what goes in each, the moment it must be updated), replacing the scattered one-liners it covers so the session start does not grow, plus a handoff checklist in the session-handoff profile
objective: New always-loaded rule .claude/rules/living-files.md (no paths frontmatter): each living file (the owner questionnaire, the question-and-answer log and its private copy, the directive registry, the research records and the owner research queue, the zoning-rule review register, the discovery backlog, the master plan, the program and coding lessons, the session notes, the handoff and the session brief), what goes in it and the exact moment it must be updated. PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE.md loses the one-liners the map replaces (the backlog duty D-069, the owner-research queue D-050, the owner-invoked handoff D-090 R941, the planned handoff D-070, the append duty in its header) and its loop-run pointer is shortened; nothing else changes. The session-handoff profile gains a living-files checklist confirmed before HANDOFF READY. The eager total reported by tools/context_budget_check.py is not larger than before the change (the owner was told the session start would not grow). No owner-worded text is edited (CLAUDE.md principles, the D-093 rule, the owner's working guidance).
business_reason: D-094-R117: the owner found that files set up for Claude to keep up to date (questionnaire, research, long-term observations) are not reliably updated between sessions; one map plus a handoff checklist makes the duty explicit and checkable without growing the session start.

acceptance_scenarios.then: it is eager (no paths frontmatter) and names every living file: the questionnaire, the question-and-answer log and its private copy, the directive registry, the research records and the owner research queue, the zoning-rule review register, the discovery backlog, the master plan, the program and coding lessons and working knowledge, the session notes, the handoff and the session brief, each with the moment it must be updated

acceptance_scenarios.given: the eager total before (the claim head) and after the change
acceptance_scenarios.then: the after total is not larger than the before total; the check exits 0 (no retired/superseded section, no duplicate)

acceptance_scenarios.when: its content is compared with the map
acceptance_scenarios.then: every duty it stated is in the map (backlog sweep and row endings D-069; owner research queue commit and push and seam line D-050; owner-invoked handoff nothing running with saved diffs D-090 R941; planned handoff seam first and no resume checks D-070, D-094 R109-R113; lessons appended when found); nothing else in PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE.md changed except the shortened loop-run pointer
it carries a living-files checklist, one item per map line, to be confirmed and reported in the handoff before HANDOFF READY
CLAUDE.md, the D-093 rule and the owner's working guidance are byte-unchanged

risks: The rule is loaded by sessions started after the merge to main; a session started earlier passes its old instruction snapshot to helpers (M0-T191): the next briefs name the map explicitly until then.
path_notes: Orchestrator-produced governance task (as M0-T193). The always-loaded rule file is new; no placeholder is seeded so that no placeholder text is ever loaded into a session.
